answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 53723 Country: India Title: Azan od Fazr in the month of Ramzan Question: In our area in the month of Ramadan, azan of Fajr is done after 5/6 minutes from the starting of Fardh time. They announce in Bengali to stop take SEHERI at the time of starting Fajr. Is it right or wrong? Answer ID: 53723 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1076/1076/M=08/1435) It is correct to give the azan of Fajr after five or six minutes from starting Fajr time. However, it is better to announce the end of Sehri time five or six minutes before the time of Fajr starts so that people stop eating Sehri five minutes earlier as precaution. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
